"""Sentinel-generated confirming test for INC-312602c9 (payments).

Hypothesis: The new retry path in `payments/gateway.py:54-63` creates a fresh gateway connection on every attempt, so a timed-out upstream call pays connection setup plus the 50 ms timeout multiple times. That makes `/pay` requests land in the ~200-300 ms range when retries are triggered, matching the observed latency spike.
"""
import statistics
import time
import tracemalloc

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from payments.app import app

client = TestClient(app)


def _call(method, url, body):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    response = client.request(method, url, content=body or None, headers={"content-type": "application/json"})
    return response, (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000


REQUEST = ('POST', '/pay', '{"email":"user43@shop.example","amount":260.57}')
BUDGET_P50_MS = 14.3  # pre-incident p50 4.27 ms, with margin
BUDGET_P95_MS = 110.1  # pre-incident p95 55.07 ms, with margin


def test_incident_request_stays_within_latency_budget():
    _call(*REQUEST)  # warm-up
    timings = sorted(_call(*REQUEST)[1] for _ in range(20))
    assert statistics.median(timings) <= BUDGET_P50_MS, timings
    assert timings[18] <= BUDGET_P95_MS, timings
